verdict.rationale: Gitea's first-party docs say Gitea Actions is compatible with GitHub Actions at both the workflow and action syntax level. They also say users can reuse thousands of existing GitHub Actions and that action plugins can be fetched from any Git website, which covers reusing both workflow definitions and community actions. The evidence is marketing-level only. missing for 10: detailed documentation of compatibility limits or unsupported GitHub Actions features, independent or hands-on confirmation that existing workflows run unmodified.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can reuse existing workflow definitions and community actions written for another platform's CI system without rewriting them

citations.quote: Gitea Actions supports CI/CD functionality, compatible with GitHub Actions. Users can write workflows in familiar YAML format and reuse a variety of existing Actions plugins.
Reuse thousands of existing GitHub Actions inside your Gitea instances.
Workflow and action syntax is compatible with GitHub Actions.
Actions plugins support downloading from any Git website.
